lessons.title: Raw Cycling Dataset Cleansing & Capacity/IR Feature Extraction
lessons.summary: Ingest multi-channel cycler logs (Arbin/Maccor/Neware), strip outlier cycles, and isolate differential capacity (dQ/dV) peaks.
inputs: End of charge/discharge voltage cutoff definitions
checkpoints: Verify capacity curve monotonically trending downward

lessons.title: Empirical Power-Law & SEI Growth Mechanistic Curve Fitting
lessons.summary: Fit square-root diffusion-limited SEI models alongside dual-exponential loss-of-lithium-inventory (LLI) functions using Scipy curve_fit.

lessons.title: Non-Parametric Bootstrap Resampling & 95% RUL Confidence Bounds
lessons.summary: Generate 1,000 synthetic degradation paths via residual resampling to project probabilistic distribution of cycle-to-80% EOL.
checkpoints: Construct kernel density estimation (KDE) plot of RUL

lessons.title: Automated Degradation Knee-Point Detection & Early Retirement Alert
lessons.summary: Formulate curvature maximization algorithms to identify second-derivative inflection points where degradation transitions from linear to exponential.
checkpoints: Alert trigger 150 cycles prior to catastrophic rollover
